name: td-synnex-pp-mcp
description: The StreamOne ION v3 reseller API (customers, catalog, orders, subscriptions, carts, reports), plus a local licence book for renewals, margin and cross-distributor true-up.

td_synnex_access_token.title: StreamOne ION access token
td_synnex_access_token.description: Optional. StreamOne ION OAuth access token (2-hour lifetime). Optional when `auth mint` has stored a token in the credentials file; an env value overrides the stored one.

td_synnex_account_id.title: TD_SYNNEX_ACCOUNT_ID
td_synnex_account_id.description: Sets TD_SYNNEX_ACCOUNT_ID for the endpoint template variable {accountId}.

td_synnex_refresh_token.title: TD_SYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN
td_synnex_refresh_token.description: Optional. Sets TD_SYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN for the TD SYNNEX StreamOne ION MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.
